allow: Bash(cmd.exe /c "where uv & where python & where pip & where node & where npx")

statusLine.command: if [ -z "${HOME-}" ]; then { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; else case "${OSTYPE-}" in msys*|cygwin*|win32*) if [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.cmd" ]; then case "${HOME-}" in *\&*|*\^*|*\(*|*\)*|*\;*|*,*|*=*|*%*|*\!*) if [ -f "${SYSTEMROOT-}/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe" ]; then "${SYSTEMROOT-}/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe" -NoProfile -EncodedCommand ; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi ;; *) "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.cmd" ;; esac; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi ;; *) if [ -f "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.sh" ] && [ -r "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.sh" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.sh" ]; then /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-statusline.sh"; else { command -p cat 2>/dev/null || cat; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi ;; esac; fi
